description:
Using the Arch workbench in FreeCAD, create a structural steel bay. 

1. Create a structural Axis System (Grid) with:
   - X-axes: 2 axes, interval 4000 mm
   - Y-axes: 2 axes, interval 3000 mm
   (Intersections at (0,0), (4000,0), (0,3000), (4000,3000))

2. Place 4 Structural Columns at the grid intersections:
   - Dimensions: 200 mm (Length) x 200 mm (Width)
   - Height: 3000 mm
   - Role: 'Column'
   - Base position: Z = 0

3. Place 2 Structural Beams connecting the tops of the columns along the X-axis:
   - Dimensions: 200 mm (Width) x 300 mm (Height)
   - Length: 4000 mm
   - Role: 'Beam'
   - Position: Resting on top of the columns (Z = 3000 mm)
   - One beam connects (0,0) to (4000,0)
   - The other beam connects (0,3000) to (4000,3000)

Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/structural_frame.FCStd'.
